profile: INmune Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing product candidates intended to reprogram the innate immune system in diseases associated with chronic inflammation and immune dysfunction. Its programs include CORDStrom, a pooled, umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stromal cell platform being developed for recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa; XPro, a protein therapeutic targeting soluble TNF; and INKmune, an NK cell-priming platform for cancer.
